title: zazz-format component diagram
description: The zazz-format library crate (lib zazz_format): the .zazz archive, its manifest, packing, the signature envelope and script ids. It builds no binary and is not deployed on its own; zazzled is the only crate of the workspace that depends on it. Its modules are drawn in the source folder's diagram.

components.name: zazz-format crate
components.responsibility: Builds the zazz_format library: a member of the macos/rust workspace whose dependencies are blake3 (ids and digests), miniz_oxide (deflate) and serde_json (manifests and envelopes).

components.name: zazz-format source
components.responsibility: The strict ZIP reader and deterministic writer, manifest parsing, directory packing, the zazz.sig envelope and script ids.

components.name: zazzled
components.responsibility: The daemon whose zazz commands pack, test, add, sign and call scripts.

relationships.description: Path dependency: its zazz module reads archives (zip::read with Limits), parses manifests (Manifest::of, Manifest::parse), packs directories (pack::pack_dir), reads and writes zazz.sig (sig::Envelope, sig::digest) and names scripts (script_id).
